HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP MARCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Hide all money underground

2. Which statement about Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship.

3. Which statement about Human developmen ts in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Human developmen ts in Africa as rumours only.
   B. Explain Human developmen ts in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Human developmen ts in Africa.
   D. Say Human developmen ts in Africa never happens in Kenya.

4. Which statement about Structure and functions of the National Government of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Structure and functions of the National Government of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Structure and functions of the National Government of Kenya as rumours only.
   C. Explain Structure and functions of the National Government of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Structure and functions of the National Government of Kenya.

5. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Name the president

6. Which statement about Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha.
   B. Say Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha as rumours only.
   D. Explain Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. Which statement about African Civilisations is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing African Civilisations.
   B. Explain African Civilisations with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat African Civilisations as rumours only.
   D. Say African Civilisations never happens in Kenya.

8. Which statement about Major Economic developments and challenges in Kenya since independence is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Major Economic developments and challenges in Kenya since independence as rumours only.
   B. Explain Major Economic developments and challenges in Kenya since independence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Major Economic developments and challenges in Kenya since independence.
   D. Say Major Economic developments and challenges in Kenya since independence never happens in Kenya.

9. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Mombasa
   C. Kisumu
   D. Nakuru

10. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Destroying road signs

11. Which statement about Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya.
   B. Treat Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya as rumours only.
   C. Say Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. Which statement about Colonialism in Contemporary Society is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Colonialism in Contemporary Society with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Colonialism in Contemporary Society.
   C. Say Colonialism in Contemporary Society never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Colonialism in Contemporary Society as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Colonialism in Contemporary Society and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Major Economic developments and challenges in Kenya since independence and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

====

1. A — Plan income and spending wisely

2. A — Explain Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. B — Explain Human developmen ts in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. C — Explain Structure and functions of the National Government of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. C — Explain symbols used on a map

6. D — Explain Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. B — Explain African Civilisations with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. B — Explain Major Economic developments and challenges in Kenya since independence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. A — Nairobi

10. A — Obeying laws and caring for public property

11. D — Explain Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Colonialism in Contemporary Society; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Major Economic developments and challenges in Kenya since independence; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
